anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), exceeding the number of cores available.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential issues with AI functionality.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss, which might suggest inactivity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Evaluate and potentially restart AI modules to ensure they are functioning and generating trading opportunities.
Review and adjust trading strategies to ensure they are actively seeking and executing trades.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate and address the high CPU load to prevent potential system instability or crashes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded performance and system outages, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to identify and resolve issues preventing learning cycles and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Review the configuration and performance of active trading strategies to ensure they are operating as intended.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring strategies are active and effective is crucial for generating trades and achieving profitability.
